body:
GitHub beamfall/corvint#785, filed by the owner 2026-10-11. Related: V1-0869 (frontier-authority-unavailable emitted on every event), V1-0243.

## Problem
Session hooks report `degradations: frontier-authority-unavailable` on every session in repositories that never produce verified CEM/OCM artifacts. Adopters can't tell whether it is a fault, a misconfiguration or expected, so it is either ignored or chased.

## Proposal
- Document what produces frontier authority, what is lost without it, and the minimum steps to enable it.
- Have the degradation carry a short `reason` (e.g. `no-verified-cem`) and a docs link.
- Optionally allow an adopter to acknowledge it as expected so hooks stop repeating it.

## Acceptance criteria
- The degradation payload includes a machine-readable reason.
- The docs page lists its causes and remedies.

title: Document `frontier-authority-unavailable` for adopters who don't produce CEM/OCM artifacts (GitHub #785)
